Concept role: dwp:Applicability.","text":"Bounded reading of the captured lower-rate branch for a claimant with no partner. DMG 78034–78036 set receipt, residence and caring conditions and the stated transitional-protection exception. In DMG 78057, Carer’s Allowance or Universal Credit including the carer element, in respect of caring for the claimant or partner, must actually be in payment before it affects entitlement to this additional amount. That is not a universal cash-payment test for disability benefits: DMG 78060 treats specified disability benefits as received for periods before an award is made but in respect of which it is awarded, or periods not covered by an award but with payment in lieu of an award, and treats CA or UC including the carer element as not received before its first payment. Its separate patient provision expressly concerns a claimant who has a partner and must not be transferred to a no-partner care-home case. Under the no-partner heading, DMG 78088 requires all conditions to remain satisfied; funding status alone does not settle them. Read these captured passages with the separate dated changes in memos 02/25, 06/25 and 01/26. This component does not consolidate those changes or determine every residence, ignored-person, funding or hospital rule."}},{"paths":[{"assertions":["https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/assertion/structured-selection/4c49483c2483cb049ebbf3d3fc89e2add8e1f90df52a25979a58543df9f259de","https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/assertion/source-reference/7da5a3c9423514b375cc3de963d761a63d8b23d216721fc903c43897d43f120a"],"records":["https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/staff-domain/carers-allowance","https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/unit/dmg/dmg-vol10-ch60/manual-structure-v1/source-0000012012-000-c8638300b7c9","https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/unit/dmg/dmg-vol10-ch60/manual-structure-v1/source-0000014228-000-adb9edd3e69f"],"seed":"https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/staff-domain/carers-allowance"}],"reasons":["Followed http://purl.org/dc/terms/references from https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/unit/dmg/dmg-vol10-ch60/manual-structure-v1/source-0000012012-000-c8638300b7c9"],"record":{"access":"public","assertion_status":"normalized","authority":{"class":"derived","label":"Exact frozen source spans; logical boundary proposal; applicability unreviewed","source":"https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69e0fdcbb5e95ca5017ed9da/dmg-Chap-60.pdf"},"evidence_unit":{"boundary_status":"machine-detected","completeness":"unresolved","joiner":"
